title: 👪 Parent Dashboard
intro: Short daily sessions work best (AAP: about 1 hour of quality media a day for ages 2–5, ideally together).
adventures: 🗺️ Today's Adventure finished on {count} of the last 7 days
limitHint: When time is up, {name} can finish the current round, then gets a goodbye screen.
progressHint: Dark bar: mastered (passed on 2 days). Light bar: passed once.
empty: Nothing recorded yet. Every answer is logged on this device as the child plays.
legend: Time = median seconds per answer. Flags need 10+ tries: too hard (under 60% right), too easy (95%+ and under 3 s), unclear (question replayed on half the tries), drop-off (a third of rounds left early).
notePlaceholder: What did you notice? (e.g. guessed fast on Bigger Number)
noVoices: This device didn't list any voices for this language, so its default voice is used.
sample: Hi! This is how I will read to you.
voiceNote: Tap a voice to hear it. Voices come from this device and are free: "Natural", "Premium", "Enhanced" and Google voices sound the most human. Online voices need internet; without it an on-device voice is used. On iPhone/iPad, download better voices in Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices. On Android, in Settings → Text-to-speech → Google → Install voice data.
